crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”
As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him…
I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”
The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

parallels.note: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Hagar
people.line: Sarah's Egyptian maidservant; mother of Ishmael.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.
translations.bsb: This is the account of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s maidservant, bore to Abraham.
translations.kjv: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
